messages:
maria: Quick sync — v2 cutover readiness. Canary scheduled Tue 2026-03-24 04:00 UTC. Need short signoffs from: SDK teams (py, js, go), telemetry, docs, infra routing. Post status + blockers and add +owner if you will take a task. Rolling plan: 1h canary -> expand.

raj: infra: routing shim is in place, but header negotiation fails for gRPC streaming under certain proxies. PR in flight: gateway#4825. ETA EOD Mon. Blocker: proxy config test flakes on aarch64 CI.

tom: qa: compatibility tests found older clients drop if Accept-Version header missing — we see fallback path writing mismatched proto. Filed INF-512 with test vectors. Short-term workaround: SDKs should set `Accept-Version: v2`.

jen: devex: i'll own the python SDK bump + docs. Will open PR tomorrow morning with migration notes and sample snippets. +owner

maria: thanks @jen. @raj @tom can infra/qa confirm telemetry events we want during rollout? We want `api.v2.migration_event` with labels `owner`, `outcome`, `slice`.

raj: infra: yes, gateway will emit a metric. Need to add `slice` tag which requires a small config change in the routing layer; i'll bundle it with the header fix PR.

tom: qa: will add assertions to smoke and perf suites. Need a stable canary endpoint URL to pin tests — who owns the DNS freeze window?

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary window: Tue 2026-03-24 04:00-05:00 UTC. Notifying #oncall. Reply `ack` to confirm.

maria: ack. If anyone cannot make this window speak up now. Also drafting migration doc — sample curl snippet for SDK teams:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \ 
  -H "Accept-Version: v2" \ 
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```

jen: sample looks good. i'll add it to the python sdk README and include a note about opt-in backcompat toggle. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/pull/279

raj: gateway PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/pull/4825 — CI failing on aarch64 due to the proxy test flake, investigating.

tom: did a quick smoke run in staging after enabling the header default; logs look clean. i'll run the full suite during the canary and report.

maria: summary: owners — python SDK (jen), infra routing (raj), QA (tom). Next sync only if blockers remain. Thanks everyone :tada:
